payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate i from 0..n-1, for each multiple j of i+1 where s[j]>s[i], update dp[j]=max(dp[j], dp[i]+1); answer is max dp.
payload.rationale: The DP state is 1D: dp[i] = longest subsequence ending at index i. Transitions only to multiples j>i. No additional dimension. Iterative bottom-up.
